market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Iran conflict and oil at $97 dominate. Yen unwind creates FX turbulence. Equities supported by dovish Fedspeak and AI earnings but capped by inflation fears. September seasonality adds headwind. Expect 2-3% S&P 500 range-bound with upside limited by oil.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex cycle and copper demand support structural growth. K-shaped economy persists. Energy transition accelerates (China oil decline). Geopolitical fragmentation raises risk premium. Fed likely to pause or slow hikes, supporting valuations by Q1 2027.
